scenes.headline: How a 33B video model runs on 8 GB
scenes.sub: FreeVideo, MiniMax H3 and Video DeltaNet
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Burrito! Today: how a thirty-three billion parameter video model runs on an eight gigabyte gaming card.

scenes.text: No single trick. Delete what depends only on the timestep, store the rest in FP8, then stream blocks through the card on a measured plan.
scenes.say: There is no single trick. Delete what depends only on the timestep, store the rest in eight-bit floats, then stream blocks through the card.

scenes.title: The transformer, before and after
scenes.note: still nearly three times the card
scenes.say: Released, the transformer is sixty-six gigabytes. Fixed timesteps turn the modulation weights into small tables. Eight-bit floats bring it to twenty-two and a half. Still too big.

scenes.title: Rent the card one block at a time

steps.say: The stack is fifty blocks. At ten seconds, an eight gigabyte card keeps none of them.
They wait in pinned host memory and cross the bus every step.
With sixteen gigabytes of RAM, part of the stack also comes off the disk.
Attention runs a few heads at a time, so the activations fit.
A planner reads free memory before every request and picks all of this from measured runs.

scenes.title: Video DeltaNet splits attention by distance

steps.label: dense H3
steps.say: Dense attention scores every frame against every other. It is most of the runtime.

steps.label: local window
steps.say: Video DeltaNet keeps exact softmax only in a local window.

steps.label: boundary anchors
steps.say: Every frame also sees the first and last frames.

steps.label: softmax + linear memory
steps.note: distant frames go to a delta-rule memory
steps.say: Everything farther away goes to a small linear memory, scanned both ways.

parts.note: decayed memory plus this frame's writes
parts.say: The new memory is the decayed old one, plus this frame's writes.

parts.note: keys in one frame account for each other
parts.say: This small inverse lets tokens with overlapping keys account for each other.

scenes.title: Cost of fitting, H200 with memory capped
scenes.note: seconds per step, not a consumer card
scenes.say: On the project's grid, an eight gigabyte card takes about one point four times as long per step. That is an H200's compute, though.

scenes.text: Placement and policy fit the model, not a smaller model. Video DeltaNet makes each streamed step cheaper.
scenes.say: Placement and policy fit the model. Video DeltaNet makes each streamed step about three times cheaper.

recap: Blocks stream from host RAM or disk
scenes.say: Tables, streaming, and attention split by distance.
